placement.claim: A dedicated Work Engine proposal-former planning capability owns interactive formation judgment and packet interaction without owning packet identity or downstream decisions.

reopening_conditions: Dogfooding shows formation and strategic portfolio reconciliation cannot be separated without repeated reconstruction.
Useful interactive continuity requires additional durable session state whose semantic owner can be identified.
Formation becomes a product-neutral capability with independent consumers that justify extraction from Work Engine.

authority.decision_owner: user or future explicitly authorized portfolio owner

relationships.rationale: Formation has a semantic dependency on the durable packet contract as the canonical target for formed and revised candidate state; this does not impose a mandatory delivery order.
